+
+# OpenBeni
+
+Canonical source: [Mondo-Robotics/open-beni](https://github.com/Mondo-Robotics/open-beni). Development and pull requests belong in this repository; the Hugging Face Space is a deployment of this source.
+
+Play the browser game at [Hugging Face Spaces](https://huggingface.co/spaces/mondo-robotics/open-beni).
+This repository contains the complete web game, server, training source, robot assets and policies under the MIT license.
+See [the web README](web/README.md) for local development, loading checks and deployment.
+
+Build and run the game from source with Docker:
+
+```bash
+docker build -t open-beni .
+docker run --rm -p 7860:7860 open-beni
+```
+
+Open `http://localhost:7860`. Hugging Face proxies port 7860 to the Space's HTTPS URL; players do not enter a port.
+Set `MAX_ROOMS=0` to disable multiplayer; the default is 10 rooms.
+For a build without a runtime CDN, pass `--build-arg VITE_ASSET_BASE_URL=`.
+
+# BENI mjlab
+
+[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
+
+Flat-terrain velocity tracking, recovery and jumping for the BENI robot, built on
+[mjlab](https://github.com/mujocolab/mjlab) and MuJoCo Warp.
+
+## Recommended Environment
+
+- Linux x86_64.
+- Python **3.12**.
+- An NVIDIA GPU (at least 8 GB memory) with a driver compatible with CUDA 12.8 for training.
+  CPU execution is available for small runs.
+- [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) for Python and dependency management.
+
+## Getting Started
+
+Install dependencies from the repository root:
+
+```bash
+uv sync --locked
+```
+
+## Training
+
+Train the BENI robot for 15,000 PPO iterations:
+
+```bash
+uv run python -m beni_rl.train Beni-Jump-Flat --env.scene.num-envs 4096 --agent.max-iterations 15000 --agent.seed 42
+```
+
+Run a small training check that automatically uses CPU when CUDA is unavailable:
+
+```bash
+uv run python -m beni_rl.train Beni-Jump-Flat \
+  --env.scene.num-envs 4 --agent.max-iterations 10
+```
+
+CPU runs use the same MuJoCo Warp backend and are slower than GPU training.
+
+Checkpoints and TensorBoard logs are saved under `logs/rsl_rl/beni_jump_flat/`.
+
+Inspect all training options with `uv run python -m beni_rl.train Beni-Jump-Flat --help`.
+
+### Multi-GPU training
+
+`python -m beni_rl.train` automatically uses all visible CUDA devices, up to eight.
+`--gpu-ids '[0,1]'` selects indices within `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES`; `--gpu-ids None`
+selects CPU.
+
+### Resume train
+
+Resume a checkpoint with additional PPO updates:
+
+```bash
+uv run --locked python -m beni_rl.train Beni-Jump-Flat \
+  --agent.resume True --agent.load-run '<run>' --agent.load-checkpoint model_4000.pt \
+  --agent.max-iterations 3000
+```
+
+Resume restores the stage, sampling progress, difficult-state membership and
+learning-rate ceiling.
+
+## Evaluation
+
+Play the policy in the browser using Viser, from the repository root:
+
+```bash
+uv run play Beni-Jump-Flat --checkpoint-file "assets/models/policy.pt" --num-envs 1 --viewer viser
+```
+
+Once Viser is ready, play automatically opens the default browser in a new window
+(or a tab, depending on browser settings). The default address is
+`http://localhost:8080`; if that port is occupied, the browser opens the port Viser
+actually selects. If no browser is available, use the URL printed in the terminal.
+
+### Controlling the robot in Viser
+
+Open **Controls → Commands → Twist** and check **Enable** to control the selected
+robot with the sliders. When unchecked, commands are sampled automatically.
+
+| Control | Range | Requested behavior |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `lin_vel_x` | −2 to 2 m/s | Forward for positive values, backward for negative values. |
+| `lin_vel_y` | Fixed at 0 | Lateral motion is disabled. |
+| `ang_vel_z` | −5 to 5 rad/s | Left turn for positive values, right turn for negative values, viewed from above. |
+| `base_pitch (rad)` | −0.1 to 0.1 rad | Requested forward/backward body tilt (pitch). |
+| `base_roll (rad)` | −0.1 to 0.1 rad | Requested left/right body tilt (roll). |
+| `base_height (m)` | 0.10 to 0.12 m | Requested body height; larger values request a taller stance, with 0.11 m at the midpoint. |
+
+For example, set `lin_vel_x = 0.5` and `ang_vel_z = 0` to drive forward, or set
+`lin_vel_x = 0` and `ang_vel_z = 1` to request a left turn in place. Set both to
+zero to request standing still; keep **Enable** checked. Combining forward speed
+and yaw rate requests a curved path. These are policy commands, so the actual
+motion and pose depend on the trained policy's tracking ability.
+
+Open **Controls → Commands → Jump** (the folder shows the fixed reference height)
+and click **Request one jump** to trigger a single jump for the selected robot.
+Jumps are triggered manually during play. To try a standing jump, keep Twist
+**Enable** checked, set both velocity commands and body tilt to zero, and set
+`base_height (m) = 0.11`. Wait for **Measured state** to show `ready=True` before
+clicking. You can also request a jump while driving forward once the robot is
+balanced. Training, play and the BENI web profile use a fixed 0.18 m jump reference,
+measured as base rise above the nominal standing height, with a matching height
+command. Checkpoint settings and uploaded model fingerprints do not change this
+reference; actual wheel clearance depends on the trained policy. The original
+trajectory file is retained as an archive; earlier policies require their matching
+source revision to reproduce their behavior.
+
+The robot must meet the balance and wheel-support conditions continuously for
+0.2 seconds before a request can be accepted. **Last request** shows `accepted`
+or a rejection reason: `not ready`, `cooldown`, `busy` or `disabled`. Before
+requesting another jump, let the robot recover its balance and wait for both
+the 1-second cooldown and the previous jump's landing monitoring to finish.
+`busy` can remain visible for several seconds after landing; wait and click
+again to submit a new request.
+
+Use **Simulation → Pause** to freeze the simulation, or **Reset Environment** to
+reset the robot after a fall. Jump requests made while paused are processed
+after resuming the simulation.
+
+### Other play options
+
+Play a trained policy, replacing `<run>` with a saved checkpoint:
+
+```bash
+uv run play Beni-Jump-Flat \
+  --checkpoint-file "logs/rsl_rl/beni_jump_flat/<run>/model_best.pt" \
+  --num-envs 1 \
+  --viewer viser
+```
+
+To inspect the robot without a checkpoint:
+
+```bash
+uv run play Beni-Jump-Flat \
+  --agent zero \
+  --num-envs 1 \
+  --viewer viser
+```
+
+## Export and deployment (ONNX + MNN)
+
+Export a checkpoint on CPU:
+
+```bash
+uv run --locked --group export python -m beni_rl.headless_export \
+  --run_dir "logs/rsl_rl/beni_jump_flat/<run>" \
+  --checkpoint model_best.pt
+```
+
+Omit `--checkpoint` to select the highest-numbered `model_*.pt` in the run.
+
+The command performs `.pt → ONNX → MNN` and writes both deployment artifacts
+under `<checkpoint-dir>/exported/<checkpoint-stem>/`:
+
+| File | Deployment use |
+| --- | --- |
+| `policy.onnx` | Policy for ONNX Runtime and the browser viewer. |
+| `policy.mnn` | Policy for MNN deployed on the robot. |
+
+## Browser game
+
+The browser MuJoCo + ONNX game lives in [`web/`](web/README.md). Build from a
+full repository checkout with Node.js 22.13+ and Python 3.9+ available as
+`python3`; no training dependencies are needed.
+
+```bash
+cd web
+npm ci
+npm run build
+npm start
+```
+
+Open `http://localhost:3000/`. The Node server listens on `0.0.0.0:3000` and
+enables Multiplayer by default; use `npm run dev` for development. Serving
+`web/dist/` alone supports Single Player only. Public Multiplayer deployment
+needs the Node server on the same origin.
+
+## Repository structure
+
+Key files and directories:

+
+"""Filter log messages from empty WebSocket probes."""
+
+import logging
+
+from websockets.exceptions import InvalidMessage
+
+
+def _keep_websocket_log(record: logging.LogRecord) -> bool:
+    if record.getMessage() != "opening handshake failed" or not record.exc_info:
+        return True
+    error = record.exc_info[1]
+    if not isinstance(error, InvalidMessage):
+        return True
+    request_error = error.__cause__
+    if not isinstance(request_error, EOFError):
+        return True
+    stream_error = request_error.__cause__
+    return not (
+        str(request_error) == "connection closed while reading HTTP request line"
+        and isinstance(stream_error, EOFError)
+        and str(stream_error) == "stream ends after 0 bytes, before end of line"
+    )
+
+
+logging.getLogger("websockets.server").addFilter(_keep_websocket_log)

+from mjlab.utils.spec import create_motor_actuator

+    from mjlab.entity import Entity

+
+def knee_spring_torque(
+    theta: torch.Tensor,
+    scale: float = 1.0,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Return passive knee spring torque in N*m for joint angles in radians.
+
+    ``scale`` multiplies the spring torque; zero disables the spring.
+    """
+    angle = theta - 1.0
+    return scale * (0.22 * torch.sin(angle) + 0.15 * torch.sin(2.0 * angle))
+
+
+@dataclass(kw_only=True)
+class BeniMotorCfg(IdealPdActuatorCfg):
+    """PD motor with constant torque limits and an optional knee spring."""
+
+    simulation_effort_limit: float | None = None
+    spring_scale: float = 0.0
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        super().__post_init__()
+        if self.simulation_effort_limit is not None and self.simulation_effort_limit < self.effort_limit:
+            raise ValueError("simulation_effort_limit cannot be below effort_limit")
+        if self.spring_scale < 0.0:
+            raise ValueError("spring_scale cannot be negative")
+
+    def build(
+        self,
+        entity: Entity,
+        target_ids: list[int],
+        target_names: list[str],
+    ) -> BeniMotor:
+        return BeniMotor(self, entity, target_ids, target_names)
+
+
+class BeniMotor(IdealPdActuator[BeniMotorCfg]):
+    """Apply PD motor torque and passive knee spring torque each physics substep."""
+
+    def edit_spec(self, spec: mujoco.MjSpec, target_names: list[str]) -> None:
+        sim_limit = (
+            self.cfg.effort_limit if self.cfg.simulation_effort_limit is None else self.cfg.simulation_effort_limit
+        )
+        for target_name in target_names:
+            self._mjs_actuators.append(
+                create_motor_actuator(
+                    spec,
+                    target_name,
+                    effort_limit=sim_limit,
+                    armature=self.cfg.armature,
+                    frictionloss=self.cfg.frictionloss,
+                    viscous_damping=self.cfg.viscous_damping,
+                    transmission_type=self.cfg.transmission_type,
+                )
+            )
+
+    def compute(self, cmd: ActuatorCmd) -> torch.Tensor:
+        motor_torque = super().compute(cmd)
+        if self.cfg.spring_scale:
+            motor_torque = motor_torque + knee_spring_torque(cmd.pos, self.cfg.spring_scale)
+        sim_limit = (
+            self.cfg.effort_limit if self.cfg.simulation_effort_limit is None else self.cfg.simulation_effort_limit
+        )
+        return motor_torque.clamp(-sim_limit, sim_limit)

+"""Small extensions to mjlab's native distributed PPO runner."""
+
+import torch
+from rsl_rl.modules.normalization import EmpiricalNormalization
+from mjlab.utils.gpu import select_gpus
+
+
+def resolve_gpu_ids(requested):
+    """Use at most eight visible devices, retaining mjlab's visible-index semantics."""
+    if requested is None:
+        return None
+    available = min(select_gpus("all")[1], torch.cuda.device_count())
+    if requested in ("auto", "all"):
+        count = min(8, available)
+        return list(range(count)) if count else None
+    if requested is not None:
+        if not requested or len(requested) > 8 or len(set(requested)) != len(requested):
+            raise ValueError("Select between one and eight distinct GPUs, or None for CPU")
+        if any(index < 0 or index >= available for index in requested):
+            raise ValueError("GPU indices must refer to visible devices")
+    return requested
+
+
+class DistributedEmpiricalNormalization(EmpiricalNormalization):
+    """Pool observations across ranks; preserve the native checkpoint/export format."""
+
+    @torch.jit.unused
+    @torch.no_grad()
+    def update(self, x):
+        if not self.training or (self.until is not None and self.count >= self.until):
+            return
+        if not torch.distributed.is_initialized():
+            return super().update(x)
+        # Center before forming second moments; float64 avoids cancellation for offsets.
+        delta = x.double() - self._mean.double()
+        width = self._mean.numel()
+        moments = torch.cat((delta.sum(0).flatten(), delta.square().sum(0).flatten(),
+                             x.new_tensor([len(x)], dtype=torch.float64)))
+        torch.distributed.all_reduce(moments)
+        n = moments[-1]
+        if n == 0:
+            return
+        shift = (moments[:width] / n).reshape_as(self._mean)
+        variance = (moments[width:2*width] / n).reshape_as(self._var) - shift.square()
+        self.count += n.long()
+        rate = n / self.count
+        self._mean.add_((rate * shift).to(self._mean.dtype))
+        self._var.add_((rate * (variance.clamp_min(0) - self._var.double()
+                               + (1-rate) * shift.square())).to(self._var.dtype))
+        self._var.clamp_min_(0)
+        self._std.copy_(self._var.sqrt())
+
+
+def synchronize_normalizers(*models):
+    for model in models:
+        old = model.obs_normalizer
+        if not isinstance(old, EmpiricalNormalization):
+            raise TypeError("Distributed BENI training requires empirical observation normalization")
+        norm = DistributedEmpiricalNormalization(old._mean.shape[1:], old.eps, old.until).to(old._mean.device)
+        norm.load_state_dict(old.state_dict())
+        norm.train(old.training)
+        model.obs_normalizer = norm

+"""Export a BENI training checkpoint to ONNX and MNN on CPU, without a simulator."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import importlib.util
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import torch
+import yaml
+from rsl_rl.models import RNNModel
+from tensordict import TensorDict
+
+
+class AgentConfigLoader(yaml.SafeLoader):
+    """Read MJLab's tuple tags without allowing arbitrary Python objects."""
+
+
+AgentConfigLoader.add_constructor(
+    "tag:yaml.org,2002:python/tuple",
+    lambda loader, node: tuple(loader.construct_sequence(node)),
+)
+
+
+def resolve_checkpoint(run_dir: Path | None, checkpoint: Path | None) -> Path:
+    if checkpoint is not None:
+        path = checkpoint.expanduser()
+        if run_dir is not None and not path.is_absolute():
+            path = run_dir.expanduser() / path
+    elif run_dir is not None:
+        candidates = [
+            path
+            for path in run_dir.expanduser().glob("model_*.pt")
+            if path.is_file() and re.fullmatch(r"model_\d+\.pt", path.name)
+        ]
+        if not candidates:
+            raise FileNotFoundError(f"No model_<iteration>.pt checkpoints found in {run_dir}")
+        path = max(candidates, key=lambda item: int(item.stem.removeprefix("model_")))
+    else:
+        raise ValueError("Provide --checkpoint /path/to/model.pt or --run_dir /path/to/run")
+    if not path.is_file():
+        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Checkpoint not found: {path}")
+    return path.resolve()
+
+
+def load_actor(checkpoint: Path, agent_config: Path) -> RNNModel:
+    """Restore the recurrent actor and its observation normalization for export."""
+    saved = torch.load(checkpoint, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
+    if not isinstance(saved, dict) or "actor_state_dict" not in saved:
+        raise ValueError("Expected an BENI MJLab checkpoint with 'actor_state_dict'")
+    with agent_config.open(encoding="utf-8") as stream:
+        config = yaml.load(stream, Loader=AgentConfigLoader)
+    if not isinstance(config, dict) or not isinstance(config.get("actor"), dict):
+        raise ValueError(f"Missing actor configuration in {agent_config}")
+    actor_cfg = config["actor"].copy()
+    if actor_cfg.pop("class_name", None) != "RNNModel":
+        raise ValueError("Only the BENI RNNModel actor is supported")
+    if actor_cfg.pop("cnn_cfg", None) is not None:
+        raise ValueError("The BENI actor must not contain a CNN")
+    if (
+        actor_cfg.get("rnn_type") != "gru"
+        or actor_cfg.get("rnn_hidden_dim") != 512
+        or actor_cfg.get("rnn_num_layers") != 1
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("The BENI deployment interface requires a single-layer GRU-512")
+    distribution = actor_cfg.get("distribution_cfg")
+    if not isinstance(distribution, dict) or distribution.get("class_name") != "GaussianDistribution":
+        raise ValueError("The BENI actor must use GaussianDistribution")
+
+    observation_count = saved['actor_state_dict']['rnn.rnn.weight_ih_l0'].shape[1]
+    if observation_count not in (40, 42):
+        raise ValueError(f'Unsupported BENI observation count: {observation_count}')
+    actor = RNNModel(
+        obs=TensorDict({"actor": torch.zeros(1, observation_count)}, batch_size=[1]),
+        obs_groups={"actor": ["actor"]},
+        obs_set="actor",
+        output_dim=7,
+        **actor_cfg,
+    )
+    # Training keeps 40 inputs; retain export support for existing 42-input checkpoints.
+    actor.load_state_dict(saved["actor_state_dict"], strict=True)
+    return actor.eval()
+
+
+def export_onnx(actor: RNNModel, output_path: Path) -> None:
+    model = actor.as_onnx().cpu().eval()
+    output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    torch.onnx.export(
+        model,
+        model.get_dummy_inputs(),
+        str(output_path),
+        export_params=True,
+        opset_version=18,
+        input_names=model.input_names,
+        output_names=model.output_names,
+        dynamic_axes={},
+        dynamo=False,
+    )
+
+
+def convert_to_mnn(onnx_path: Path, mnn_path: Path, fp16: bool) -> None:
+    if importlib.util.find_spec("MNN") is None:
+        raise FileNotFoundError(
+            "MNN is missing. Run: uv run --group export python -m beni_rl.headless_export ... "
+            "(use --skip_mnn for ONNX only)."
+        )
+    # Some converter versions return zero without producing a model. Convert into
+    # a fresh directory so an older policy.mnn cannot be mistaken for success.
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix=".mnn-export-", dir=mnn_path.parent) as directory:
+        temporary_model = Path(directory) / "policy.mnn"
+        command = [
+            sys.executable,
+            "-c",
+            # The CLI wrapper imports a logger that runs system pip. Use the
+            # same converter binding from the uv-installed wheel directly.
+            "import sys; import _tools; _tools.mnnconvert(sys.argv)",
+            "-f",
+            "ONNX",
+            "--modelFile",
+            str(onnx_path),
+            "--MNNModel",
+            str(temporary_model),
+            "--optimizeLevel",
+            "1",
+            "--optimizePrefer",
+            "2",
+            "--bizCode",
+            "OpenBeni",
+        ]
+        if fp16:
+            command.append("--fp16")
+        subprocess.run(command, check=True)
+        if not temporary_model.is_file() or temporary_model.stat().st_size == 0:
+            raise RuntimeError("MNN conversion did not produce a nonempty model")
+        temporary_model.replace(mnn_path)
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--run_dir", "--run-dir", type=Path, help="Training run; defaults to its latest checkpoint")
+    parser.add_argument("--checkpoint", type=Path, help="Checkpoint path, or filename relative to --run_dir")
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--agent_config",
+        "--agent-config",
+        type=Path,
+        help="Default: <checkpoint-dir>/params/agent.yaml",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--output_dir",
+        "--output-dir",
+        type=Path,
+        help="Default: <checkpoint-dir>/exported/<checkpoint-stem>",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--skip_mnn", "--skip-mnn", action="store_true", help="Export ONNX only")
+    parser.add_argument("--fp32", action="store_true", help="Store MNN weights in FP32 (default: FP16)")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    if args.run_dir is None and args.checkpoint is None:
+        parser.error("--run_dir or --checkpoint is required")
+
+    checkpoint = resolve_checkpoint(args.run_dir, args.checkpoint)
+    agent_config = args.agent_config.expanduser() if args.agent_config else checkpoint.parent / "params" / "agent.yaml"
+    output_dir = (
+        args.output_dir.expanduser().resolve() if args.output_dir else checkpoint.parent / "exported" / checkpoint.stem
+    )
+    actor = load_actor(checkpoint, agent_config)
+    print(f"Checkpoint: {checkpoint}", flush=True)
+    onnx_path = output_dir / "policy.onnx"
+    export_onnx(actor, onnx_path)
+    print(f"ONNX: {onnx_path}", flush=True)
+    if not args.skip_mnn:
+        mnn_path = output_dir / "policy.mnn"
+        convert_to_mnn(onnx_path, mnn_path, fp16=not args.fp32)
+        print(f"MNN: {mnn_path}", flush=True)
+    width = actor.rnn.rnn.input_size
+    print(f"Inputs: obs [1,{width}], h_in [1,1,512]; outputs: actions [1,7], h_out [1,1,512]")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+                  clearance_m=.01, air_hold_s=.05, ascent_vz_m_s=.05,
+                  takeoff_deadline_s=.8, protection_s=2., landing_ramp_s=.2,

+                  readiness_s=.2, flight_tilt_deg=30.)
+READINESS_THRESHOLDS = dict(tilt_deg=20., height_tolerance_m=.025, joint_error_rad=.30,
+                    margin_rad=.02, load_mg=.7, angular_speed_rad_s=2.)
+DIRECTION_TOLERANCE_M = 1e-5

+STANDING_LEG_LENGTH_M = (.08095823563057503, .08060120486022314)
+TUCK_KNEE_RAD = (Q_REF['L2'] + .15, Q_REF['R2'] + .15)
+TUCK_LEG_LENGTH_M = tuple(x - .005 for x in STANDING_LEG_LENGTH_M)
+
+
+THRESHOLDS.update(goal_clearance_m=.08, tuck_knee_rad=TUCK_KNEE_RAD,
+                  tuck_length_m=TUCK_LEG_LENGTH_M, tuck_at_apex_required=True)
+
+
+class JumpMeasurement:
+    def __init__(self, env):
+        robot = env.scene['robot']
+        self.legs = robot.find_joints(list(Q_REF), preserve_order=True)[0]
+        self.knees = robot.find_joints(('L2', 'R2'), preserve_order=True)[0]
+        self.hips = robot.find_bodies(('L1_Link', 'R1_Link'), preserve_order=True)[0]
+        self.wheels = robot.find_bodies(('LW_Link', 'RW_Link'), preserve_order=True)[0]
+        self.geoms = robot.find_geoms(('LW_collision', 'RW_collision'), preserve_order=True)[0]
+        self.ref = torch.tensor(list(Q_REF.values()), device=env.device)
+        self.weight = float(env.sim.mj_model.body_mass.sum() * 9.81)
+
+    def __call__(self, env):
+        d = env.scene['robot'].data
+        force = env.scene['wheel_ground_contact'].data.force
+        body_force = env.scene['body_ground_contact'].data.force
+        contacts = force.norm(dim=-1) > .1
+        body = (body_force.norm(dim=-1) > .1).any(-1)
+        history = env.scene['body_ground_contact'].data.force_history
+        # Detect body contacts across every physics substep in the control interval.
+        if history is None or history.shape[-2] != env.cfg.decimation:
+            raise ValueError('Jump body evidence requires one full control interval of force history')
+        peak = history.norm(dim=-1).amax(-1)
+        evidence = dict(body_current=body, body_substep_force_max=peak)
+        body = (peak > .1).any(-1)
+        q = d.joint_pos[:, self.legs]
+        limits = d.joint_pos_limits[:, self.legs]
+        margin = torch.minimum(q-limits[..., 0], limits[..., 1]-q).amin(-1)
+        height = mdp.base_height(env).squeeze(-1)
+        tilt = torch.rad2deg(torch.acos((-d.projected_gravity_b[:, 2]).clamp(-1, 1)))
+        load = (-force[..., 2]).clamp_min(0).sum(-1) / self.weight
+        error = (q-self.ref).abs().amax(-1)
+        speed = d.root_link_lin_vel_w[:, :2].norm(dim=-1)
+        angular = d.root_link_ang_vel_w.norm(dim=-1)
+        stable = ((tilt < 20) & ((height-H_REF).abs() <= .01) & (error <= .10) &
+                  (margin > .02) & contacts.all(-1) & (load >= .7) & ~body &
+                  (speed < .3) & (angular < 2))
+        r = READINESS_THRESHOLDS
+        jump_ready = ((tilt < r['tilt_deg']) & ((height-H_REF).abs() <= r['height_tolerance_m']) &
+                      (error <= r['joint_error_rad']) & (margin > r['margin_rad']) &
+                      contacts.all(-1) & (load >= r['load_mg']) & ~body & (angular < r['angular_speed_rad_s']))
+        quat = d.geom_quat_w[:, self.geoms]
+        axis = torch.zeros_like(quat[..., :3]); axis[..., 2] = 1
+        vertical = quat_apply(quat, axis)[..., 2].abs()
+        extent = .038 * (1-vertical.square()).clamp_min(0).sqrt() + .0105 * vertical
+        clearance = d.geom_pos_w[:, self.geoms, 2] - env.scene.env_origins[:, 2:3] - extent
+        air = ~contacts.any(-1) & ~body & (clearance >= THRESHOLDS['clearance_m']).all(-1)
+        return dict(height=height, vz=d.root_link_lin_vel_w[:, 2], tilt=tilt, body=body,
+                    position_xy=d.root_link_pos_w[:, :2], velocity_xy=d.root_link_lin_vel_w[:, :2],
+                    quat=d.root_link_quat_w,
+                    contacts=contacts, load=load, stable=stable, jump_ready=jump_ready, margin=margin, error=error,
+                    knee=d.joint_pos[:, self.knees],
+                    length=(d.body_link_pos_w[:, self.wheels]-d.body_link_pos_w[:, self.hips]).norm(dim=-1),
+                    clearance=clearance, air=air, impact=force.norm(dim=-1).amax(-1), **evidence)
+

+def strong_tuck_progress(knee, length, knee0, length0, margin):
+    """Measure bilateral knee flexion and leg shortening toward the tucked pose."""
+    required_knee = (knee.new_tensor(TUCK_KNEE_RAD) - knee0).clamp_min(THRESHOLDS['knee_delta_rad'])
+    required_length = (length0 - length.new_tensor(TUCK_LEG_LENGTH_M)).clamp_min(THRESHOLDS['retraction_m'])
+    progress = torch.minimum((knee-knee0)/required_knee, (length0-length)/required_length)
+    return progress.clamp(0, 1).amin(-1) * (margin > .02)
+
+

+def restore_checkpoint_jump_config(env_cfg, checkpoint_file: str) -> None:
+    """Restore saved distance/cooldown settings with the fixed BENI Jump reference.
+
+    Keep play's manual trigger, disabled curriculum/noise and reset settings.
+    The training YAML contains Python tags; BaseLoader treats them as inert data.
+    """
+    jump = env_cfg.commands.get('jump')
+    if not isinstance(jump, BeniJumpCommandCfg):
+        return
+    path = Path(checkpoint_file).expanduser().parent / 'params' / 'env.yaml'
+    if not path.is_file():
+        print(f'[WARN]: No checkpoint environment config at {path}; '
+              f'using task defaults (Jump reference {jump.reference_height:g} m).')
+        return
+    try:
+        saved = yaml.load(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'), Loader=yaml.BaseLoader)['commands']['jump']
+        if not isinstance(saved, dict):
+            raise ValueError('commands.jump must be a mapping')
+        values = saved.get('distance_range', jump.distance_range)
+        if not isinstance(values, (tuple, list)) or len(values) != 2:
+            raise ValueError('distance_range must contain two numbers')
+        distance_range = tuple(float(x) for x in values)
+        if not all(math.isfinite(x) for x in distance_range) or distance_range[0] > distance_range[1]:
+            raise ValueError('distance_range must be finite and ordered')
+        cooldown = int(saved.get('cool_down_steps', jump.cool_down_steps))
+        if cooldown < 0:
+            raise ValueError('cool_down_steps must be nonnegative')
+    except (yaml.YAMLError, KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, FileNotFoundError) as error:
+        raise ValueError(f'Invalid checkpoint Jump configuration in {path}: {error}') from error
+    jump.distance_range = distance_range
+    jump.cool_down_steps = cooldown
+    print(f'[INFO]: Loaded checkpoint Jump config: {path}\n'
+          f'[INFO]: Jump reference {jump.reference_height:g} m ({jump.reference_path.name}); '
+          'training and play use the fixed reference.')
+
+
+def _run_play(task_id, cfg, run_play):
+    """Apply checkpoint settings after CLI parsing and before mjlab creates the env."""
+    original_loader = mjlab_play.load_env_cfg
+
+    def load_env_cfg(name, play=False):
+        env_cfg = original_loader(name, play=play)
+        if play and name == task_id and cfg.agent == 'trained' and cfg.checkpoint_file is not None:
+            restore_checkpoint_jump_config(env_cfg, cfg.checkpoint_file)
+        return env_cfg
+
+    mjlab_play.load_env_cfg = load_env_cfg
+    try:

+    finally:

+
+
+def _open_browser(url: str) -> None:
+    try:
+        opened = webbrowser.open_new(url)
+    except (webbrowser.Error, OSError):

+        Thread(target=_open_browser, args=(url,), daemon=True).start()
+
+
+def main() -> None:

+    original_run_play = mjlab_play.run_play
+    mjlab_play.ViserPlayViewer = BeniViserPlayViewer
+    mjlab_play.run_play = lambda task_id, cfg: _run_play(task_id, cfg, original_run_play)

+        mjlab_play.ViserPlayViewer = original_viewer
+        mjlab_play.run_play = original_run_play

+
+if __name__ == "__main__":

+
+import math

+import torch
+from mjlab.envs import mdp as envs_mdp
+from mjlab.managers import SceneEntityCfg
+from mjlab.utils.lab_api.math import quat_apply
+
+from . import mdp
+
+# Joint angles and base height used by standing rewards.
+Q_REF = {"L1": .2848744094, "R1": .2899141610, "L2": .4957503676, "R2": .5020063519}
+H_REF = .1101198718
+HEAD_REF = -.0133943176
+
+
+def restore_recorded_state(env, qpos, qvel, env_ids=None):
+    """Restore recorded state, converting root angular velocity from body to world coordinates."""
+    robot = env.scene["robot"]
+    velocity_w = torch.cat((qvel[:, :3], quat_apply(qpos[:, 3:7], qvel[:, 3:6])), dim=-1)
+    robot.write_root_link_pose_to_sim(qpos[:, :7], env_ids=env_ids)
+    robot.write_root_link_velocity_to_sim(velocity_w, env_ids=env_ids)
+    robot.write_joint_state_to_sim(qpos[:, 7:], qvel[:, 6:], env_ids=env_ids)
+
+
+def near_upright(env):
+    """Fade posture constraints out between 30 and 80 degrees, independent of contact."""
+    cosine = -env.scene["robot"].data.projected_gravity_b[:, 2]
+    low, high = math.cos(math.radians(80)), math.cos(math.radians(30))
+    return ((cosine-low)/(high-low)).clamp(0, 1)
+
+
+def height_error(env):
+    height = mdp.base_height(env).squeeze(1)
+    target = mdp.base_pose_command(env)[:, 2]
+    active = near_upright(env)
+    # Track commanded height near upright; penalize low base height during falls.
+    return active * (height-target).square() + (1-active) * (H_REF-height).clamp_min(0) / 15
+
+
+class posture_error:
+    def __init__(self, cfg, env):
+        self.ids, _ = env.scene["robot"].find_joints(list(Q_REF), preserve_order=True)
+        self.reference = torch.tensor(list(Q_REF.values()), device=env.device)
+        self.head_id = env.scene["robot"].find_joints("head_yaw_joint")[0][0]
+
+    def __call__(self, env, head_weight=0.0):
+        command = env.command_manager.get_command("twist")
+        moving = command.norm(dim=-1) > .05
+        std = torch.where(moving, .35, .20)
+        error = (env.scene["robot"].data.joint_pos[:, self.ids]-self.reference)/std[:, None]
+        # Bound each joint's posture error to [0, 1).
+        penalty = (1-torch.rsqrt(1+error.square())).mean(-1)
+        if head_weight:
+            # Apply the head posture cost independently of the leg errors.
+            head_error = (env.scene["robot"].data.joint_pos[:, self.head_id]-HEAD_REF)/.5
+            penalty += head_weight * (1-torch.rsqrt(1+head_error.square()))
+        return penalty*near_upright(env)
+
+
+def position_limits(env, asset_cfg, target_margin=1.0):
+    robot = env.scene[asset_cfg.name]
+    actual = envs_mdp.joint_pos_limits(env, asset_cfg)
+    limits = robot.data.joint_pos_limits[:, asset_cfg.joint_ids]
+    target = robot.data.joint_pos_target[:, asset_cfg.joint_ids]
+    # Penalize PD targets beyond the joint limits plus target_margin.
+    excess = (limits[..., 0]-target_margin-target).clamp_min(0)
+    excess += (target-limits[..., 1]-target_margin).clamp_min(0)
+    return actual + .1 * excess.sum(-1)
+
+
+def joint_velocity(env, asset_cfg):
+    robot = env.scene[asset_cfg.name]
+    velocity = robot.data.joint_vel[:, asset_cfg.joint_ids]
+    wheels = mdp._contact_mask(env, "wheel_ground_contact", .1, use_history=False)
+    # Penalize unloaded wheels above the speed threshold.
+    wheel_excess = (velocity[:, 4:].abs()-83.7758).clamp_min(0) * (~wheels)
+    return velocity[:, :4].square().sum(-1) + wheel_excess.square().sum(-1)
+
+
+def configure_recovery_rewards(cfg):
+    """Configure recovery posture, height, joint-limit and termination rewards."""
+    before = set(cfg.rewards)
+    # Reward weights are scaled by control dt; time-limit truncations are excluded.
+    cfg.rewards["termination_penalty"].weight = -2500.
+    term = cfg.rewards["base_height"]
+    term.func, term.weight, term.params = height_error, -1500., {}
+    term = cfg.rewards["pose"]
+    term.func, term.weight, term.params = posture_error, -1.5, {}
+    term.params["head_weight"] = .2
+    term = cfg.rewards["joint_pos_limits"]
+    term.func = position_limits
+    term = cfg.rewards["leg_joint_vel"]
+    term.func = joint_velocity
+    term.params = {"asset_cfg": SceneEntityCfg("robot", joint_names=(*Q_REF, "LW", "RW"), preserve_order=True)}
+    assert set(cfg.rewards) == before
+
+
+def sampling_metrics(env, env_ids=None):
+    del env_ids
+    if not hasattr(env, "_recovery_reset_kind"):
+        return
+    if not hasattr(env, "_curriculum_kind"):
+        frames = torch.bincount(env._recovery_reset_kind, minlength=6)
+        if not hasattr(env, "_recovery_frame_counts"):
+            env._recovery_frame_counts = torch.zeros(6, device=env.device)
+        env._recovery_frame_counts += frames
+        log = env.extras.setdefault("log", {})
+        for i, name in enumerate(("normal", "supine", "prone", "left_side", "right_side", "support")):
+            log[f"Recovery/{name}_reset_share"] = env._recovery_reset_counts[i]/env._recovery_reset_counts.sum().clamp_min(1)
+            log[f"Recovery/{name}_frame_share"] = env._recovery_frame_counts[i]/env._recovery_frame_counts.sum().clamp_min(1)
+        log["Recovery/fallen_reset_share"] = env._recovery_reset_counts[1:5].sum()/env._recovery_reset_counts.sum().clamp_min(1)
+        log["Recovery/fallen_frame_share"] = env._recovery_frame_counts[1:5].sum()/env._recovery_frame_counts.sum().clamp_min(1)
+    log = env.extras.setdefault("log", {})
+    # Measure current physical states separately from episode reset categories.
+    robot = env.scene["robot"]
+    height = mdp.base_height(env).squeeze(1)
+    tilt = mdp.base_tilt(env)
+    wheels = mdp._contact_mask(env, "wheel_ground_contact", .1, use_history=False)
+    body = mdp._contact_mask(env, "body_ground_contact", .1).any(-1)
+    supported = wheels.all(-1) & ~body & (tilt < math.radians(20))
+    physical = torch.stack((body & ((tilt >= math.radians(70)) | (height < .065)),
+                            body & ~wheels.any(-1) & (tilt < math.radians(20)), supported), dim=-1)
+    if not hasattr(env, "_recovery_physical_counts"):
+        env._recovery_physical_counts = torch.zeros(3, device=env.device)
+        env._recovery_physical_frames = 0
+        env._recovery_leg_ids = robot.find_joints(list(Q_REF), preserve_order=True)[0]
+        env._recovery_q_ref = torch.tensor(list(Q_REF.values()), device=env.device)
+    env._recovery_physical_counts += physical.sum(0)
+    env._recovery_physical_frames += env.num_envs
+    for i, name in enumerate(("fallen", "upright_no_wheels", "supported")):
+        log[f"Recovery/physical_{name}_frame_share"] = env._recovery_physical_counts[i]/env._recovery_physical_frames
+    for i, name in enumerate(("fallen", "upright_no_wheels", "supported")):
+        log[f"Recovery/physical_{name}_current_share"] = physical[:, i].float().mean()
+    ids = env._recovery_leg_ids
+    limits = robot.data.joint_pos_limits[:, ids]
+    q = robot.data.joint_pos[:, ids]
+    margin = torch.minimum(q-limits[..., 0], limits[..., 1]-q).amin(-1)
+    log["Recovery/near_leg_limit_current_share"] = (margin <= .02).float().mean()
+    count = supported.sum().clamp_min(1)
+    error = (robot.data.joint_pos[:, env._recovery_leg_ids]-env._recovery_q_ref).abs().amax(-1)
+    log["Recovery/supported_height_mean_m"] = (height*supported).sum()/count
+    log["Recovery/supported_leg_error_mean_rad"] = (error*supported).sum()/count

+
+import hashlib
+from pathlib import Path
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+from mjlab.utils.lab_api.math import quat_apply
+
+SUBGROUPS = ("base_front_free", "base_front_head", "base_rear_free", "base_rear_head",
+             "legs_folded", "legs_asymmetric", "legs_extended")
+
+
+def recovery_subgroups(env, sample):
+    """End faces point down within 15 degrees; distinguish head-assisted support."""
+    robot = env.scene['robot']
+    sensor = env.scene['body_ground_contact']
+    forces = sensor.data.force.norm(dim=-1) > .1
+    def contact(suffix):
+        return forces[:, [i for i,n in enumerate(sensor.primary_names) if n.endswith(suffix)]].any(-1)
+    base = contact('base_link')
+    head = contact('head')
+    legs = contact(('1_Link', '2_Link'))
+    wheels = sample['contacts'].any(-1)
+    axis = torch.zeros_like(robot.data.root_link_pos_w)
+    axis[:, 0] = 1
+    vertical = quat_apply(robot.data.root_link_quat_w, axis)[:, 2]
+    front = (vertical < -.9659258263) & base & ~legs & ~wheels
+    rear = (vertical > .9659258263) & base & ~legs & ~wheels
+    joint_ids = robot.find_joints(('L1', 'R1', 'L2', 'R2'), preserve_order=True)[0]
+    q = robot.data.joint_pos[:, joint_ids]
+    asymmetric = (q[:,0]-q[:,1]).abs() > .4
+    asymmetric |= (q[:,2]-q[:,3]).abs() > .4
+    folded = (q[:,2:] > 1.).all(-1) & ~asymmetric
+    extended = (q[:,2:] < .8).all(-1) & ~asymmetric
+    return torch.stack((front & ~head, front & head, rear & ~head, rear & head,
+                        folded, asymmetric, extended), -1)
+
+
+def load_recovery_bank(path):
+    """Read arrays without pickles, rejecting malformed data before simulation."""
+    from .recovery_curriculum import KINDS
+    with np.load(path, allow_pickle=False) as archive:
+        data = {key: archive[key] for key in archive.files}
+    if 'subgroup_names' in data and tuple(data['subgroup_names']) != SUBGROUPS:
+        raise ValueError('Recovery subgroup schema does not match this implementation')
+    for name in KINDS[1:]:
+        q, v = data[f'{name}_qpos'], data[f'{name}_qvel']
+        if (q.ndim != 2 or v.ndim != 2 or not len(q) or len(q) != len(v)
+                or q.shape[1] != 15 or v.shape[1] != 14
+                or not np.isfinite(q).all() or not np.isfinite(v).all()
+                or not np.allclose(np.linalg.norm(q[:,3:7], axis=1), 1., atol=1e-4)):
+            raise ValueError(f'Invalid recovery states in {path}: {name}')
+        if f'{name}_tags' in data and (data[f'{name}_tags'].shape != (len(q), len(SUBGROUPS))
+                                      or data[f'{name}_tags'].dtype != np.bool_):
+            raise ValueError(f'Invalid recovery subgroup labels: {name}')
+    return data
+
+
+def bank_digest(path):
+    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def update_hard_states(failures, groups, result):
+    """Retain states failing/slower than 3s in two training-side checks.
+
+    Deduplicate overlapping broad/subgroup trials within a single check. Membership
+    only grows during a run; held-out results must never be passed to this function.
+    """
+    candidates = {}
+    for scenario in result['scenarios'].values():
+        for row in scenario['trials']:
+            if row['valid'] and (not row['recovered'] or row['recovery_s'] > 3.):
+                candidates[(row['kind'],row['index'])] = row
+    for (kind,index),row in candidates.items():
+        key = f'{kind}/{index}'
+        failures[key] = failures.get(key,0)+1
+        if failures[key] < 2: continue
+        by_kind = groups.setdefault(kind,{})
+        for subgroup in row['subgroups'] or ('other',):
+            by_kind[subgroup] = sorted(set(by_kind.get(subgroup,())) | {index})
+
+
+def sample_bank_indices(size, count, device, hard_groups=()):
+    """Half uniform coverage, half uniform hard subgroup then uniform state."""
+    indices = torch.randint(size,(count,),device=device)
+    if not hard_groups: return indices
+    selected = (torch.rand(count,device=device) < .5).nonzero().flatten()
+    group_ids = torch.randint(len(hard_groups),(len(selected),),device=device)
+    for i,group in enumerate(hard_groups):
+        positions = selected[group_ids == i]
+        indices[positions] = group[torch.randint(len(group),(len(positions),),device=device)]
+    return indices

+         'leg_support', 'head_support', 'one_wheel', 'mixed_support')
+BANK_VERSION = 2
+CONSOLIDATION_UPDATES = 500
+DEFAULT_TRAINING_STATE_BANK = ASSETS_DIR / 'motions' / 'recovery_contact_states_train.npz'

+
+def consolidation_progress(iteration, state):
+    return 0. if state is None else min(1., max(0., (iteration-state['start_updates'])/CONSOLIDATION_UPDATES))
+
+
+
+def training_state_bank(path=None):
+    """Return a training bank after checking its recovery-state schema."""
+    path = Path(path) if path is not None else DEFAULT_TRAINING_STATE_BANK
+    from .recovery_bank import load_recovery_bank
+    load_recovery_bank(path)
+    return path
+
+
+def probabilities(iteration, supine_sampling_restore_start=None, consolidation=None, recovery_probabilities=None):
+    """Ramp to 25% supine resets between updates 750 and 3000.
+
+    After all grounding curricula finish, blend to 20% normal over 500 updates.
+    After supine grounding is mastered, gradually reduce supine reset sampling.
+    """
+    if consolidation is not None:
+        if recovery_probabilities is None:
+            raise ValueError('Consolidation requires the actual whole-bank recovery probabilities')
+        fraction = consolidation_progress(iteration, consolidation)
+        target = [.20, *(.8 * p for p in recovery_probabilities)]
+        return [(1-fraction)*initial + fraction*target for initial, target in
+                zip(consolidation['initial_probabilities'], target)]
+    progress = min(1., max(0., (iteration - 750) / 2250))
+    restored = (0. if supine_sampling_restore_start is None else
+                min(1., max(0., (iteration - supine_sampling_restore_start) / 500)))
+    supine = .25 + (.40 / 3 - .25) * restored
+    recovery = [supine * progress, *([.40 / 3 * progress] * 2), *([.03 * progress] * 5)]
+    return [1 - sum(recovery), *recovery]
+
+
+def grounding_probability(iteration):
+    """Ramp grounded-fall probability from zero at update 1500 to one at 3000."""
+    return min(1., max(0., (iteration - 1500) / 1500))

+def reset_airborne_fall(env, ids, kind):

+    from mjlab.utils.lab_api.math import quat_from_euler_xyz
+    robot = env.scene['robot']
+    state = robot.data.default_root_state[ids].clone()
+    state[:, :3] += env.scene.env_origins[ids]
+    state[:, 2] += .06
+    angles = torch.empty(len(ids), 3, device=env.device).uniform_(-.15, .15)
+    angles[:, 2].uniform_(-math.pi, math.pi)
+    if kind == 3:
+        angles[:, 0] += math.pi
+    else:
+        angles[:, 1] += -math.pi / 2 if kind == 1 else math.pi / 2
+    state[:, 3:7] = quat_from_euler_xyz(*angles.unbind(-1))
+    robot.write_root_link_pose_to_sim(state[:, :7], env_ids=ids)
+    robot.write_root_link_velocity_to_sim(torch.zeros_like(state[:, 7:]), env_ids=ids)

+    def learn(self, num_learning_iterations: int, init_at_random_ep_len: bool = False) -> None:
+        env = self.env.unwrapped
+        # On resume, num_learning_iterations specifies additional updates.
+        self.current_learning_iteration = self._completed_updates
+        if "jump" in env.cfg.commands:
+            self._configure_jump()
+            self._configure_supine_curriculum()
+            # A resumed checkpoint may already exceed the configured Jump update limit.
+            self._check_jump_deadline()
+        if self._resumed:
+            # Checkpoints contain model/optimizer/curriculum state, not simulator episodes.
+            self.env.reset()
+            self.alg.actor.reset()
+            self.alg.critic.reset()
+            self._resumed = False
+        if "fallen_reset_probability" in env.curriculum_manager.active_terms:
+            curriculum = env.curriculum_manager.get_term_cfg("fallen_reset_probability")
+            curriculum.params.update(
+                steps_per_iteration=self.cfg["num_steps_per_env"],
+                start_iteration=self.current_learning_iteration,
+                start_step=env.common_step_counter,
+            )
+            # Begin the configured reset curriculum with fresh episodes and GRU state.
+            self.env.reset()
+            self.alg.actor.reset()
+            self.alg.critic.reset()
+        try:
+            super().learn(num_learning_iterations, init_at_random_ep_len)
+        except Exception:
+            recorder = getattr(env, '_wheel_overspeed', None)
+            if recorder is not None:
+                try:
+                    recorder.dump_failure(env)
+                except Exception as exc:
+                    print(f'[WARN] Failed to save wheel diagnostics: {exc}', flush=True)
+            raise
+        if 'jump' in env.cfg.commands and self._jump_state is None:
+            print('[Recovery curriculum] Budget finished in foundation; recovery has not passed and Jump remains disabled.',
+                  flush=True)
+        if 'jump' in env.cfg.commands and env.cfg.commands['jump'].best_checkpoint.enabled and self.logger.log_dir:
+            if self._best_checkpoint is None:
+                print('[Best Jump checkpoint] No eligible checkpoints were evaluated.', flush=True)
+            else:
+                print('[Best Jump checkpoint]', Path(self.logger.log_dir)/'model_best.pt',
+                      'completed updates:', self._best_checkpoint['completed_updates'], flush=True)

+    def load(self, path, load_cfg=None, strict=True, map_location=None):
+        # Clone inference-mode buffers before loading checkpoint values.
+        with torch.inference_mode(False):
+            for model in (self.alg.actor, self.alg.critic):
+                for module in model.modules():
+                    for name, value in module.named_buffers(recurse=False):
+                        if value.is_inference():
+                            module._buffers[name] = value.clone()
+        if load_cfg is not None and not load_cfg.get('iteration', False):
+            return super().load(path, load_cfg, strict, map_location or self.device)
+        infos = super().load(path, load_cfg, strict, map_location or self.device) or {}
+        state = infos.get('beni_training', {})
+        self._completed_updates = state.get('completed_updates', self.current_learning_iteration+1)
+        # Continue at the update following the checkpoint's last completed label.
+        self.current_learning_iteration = self._completed_updates
+        self.env.unwrapped.common_step_counter = self._completed_updates*self.cfg['num_steps_per_env']
+        self._resumed = True
+        self._last_recovery_check = state.get('last_recovery_check', 0)
+        self._recovery_passes = state.get('recovery_passes', 0)
+        self._last_performance_check = state.get('last_performance_check', 0)
+        self._best_recovery_checkpoint = state.get('best_recovery_checkpoint')
+        self._hard_failures = state.get('hard_failures', {})
+        self._hard_groups = state.get('hard_groups', {})
+        if state.get('bank_sha256') != self._bank_sha256:
+            self._hard_failures = {}; self._hard_groups = {}
+            self._recovery_passes = 0
+            self._last_recovery_check = 0
+        self._configure_hard_sampling()
+        sampler = getattr(self.env.unwrapped, '_recovery_sampler', None)
+        if sampler is not None:
+            if not sampler.load_state_dict(state.get('recovery_sampling')):
+                # Incompatible sampling history requires fresh recovery gate evidence.
+                self._recovery_passes = 0
+                sampler.last_update = self._completed_updates
+            if sampler.last_update > self._completed_updates:
+                raise ValueError('Recovery sampling state is ahead of the saved training iteration')
+        if 'jump' not in self.env.unwrapped.cfg.commands:
+            return infos
+        # Checkpoints without a saved supine level use their elapsed update count.
+        self._supine_grounding_probability = state.get('supine_grounding_probability',
+                                                       grounding_probability(self._completed_updates))
+        if not 0 <= self._supine_grounding_probability <= 1:
+            raise ValueError('Invalid saved supine grounding probability')
+        self._last_supine_check = state.get('last_supine_check', self._completed_updates)
+        self._supine_sampling_restore_start = state.get('supine_sampling_restore_start')
+        self._consolidation = state.get('consolidation')
+        if self._consolidation is not None:
+            initial = self._consolidation['initial_probabilities']
+            if (len(initial) != 9 or any(not math.isfinite(p) or p < 0 for p in initial)
+                    or not math.isclose(sum(initial), 1., abs_tol=1e-6)
+                    or not 0 <= self._consolidation['start_updates'] <= self._completed_updates):
+                raise ValueError('Invalid saved recovery consolidation schedule')
+        self._jump_state = state.get('jump')
+        self._jump_prior_primed = state.get('jump_prior_primed', False)
+        gate = self.env.unwrapped.cfg.commands['jump'].recovery_gate
+        if state and (recovery_gate_signature(state.get('recovery_gate', {})) != recovery_gate_signature(gate) or state.get('recovery_seed') != self._curriculum_seed
+                      or state.get('recovery_protocol') != RECOVERY_PROTOCOL):
+            self._recovery_passes = 0
+            self._last_recovery_check = 0
+        if not state:
+            self._load_legacy_curriculum(Path(path))
+        self._configure_supine_curriculum()
+        if self._jump_state is not None:
+            # Preserve Jump timing while discarding obsolete actor freezing state.
+            self._jump_state = {key: value for key, value in self._jump_state.items() if key != 'freeze'}
+            self._jump_state['learning_mode'] = 'full_actor'
+            if self.gpu_global_rank == 0 and self.logger.log_dir:
+                root = Path(self.logger.log_dir)
+                root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+                (root/'jump_transition.json').write_text(json.dumps(self._jump_state, indent=2)+'\n')
+        self._restore_best_checkpoint(path, state.get('best_checkpoint'))
+        self._restore_best_recovery(path, state.get('best_recovery_checkpoint'))
+        return infos

+    def _restore_best_recovery(self, path, record):
+        self._best_recovery_checkpoint = None

+        if (not record or record.get('protocol') != RECOVERY_PROTOCOL
+                or recovery_gate_signature(record.get('evaluation', {})) != recovery_gate_signature(cfg)
+                or not Path(cfg.heldout_bank).is_file()
+                or record.get('bank_sha256') != bank_digest(cfg.heldout_bank)
+                or not record.get('score') or not all(map(math.isfinite,record['score']))):
+            return
+        source = (Path(path) if record['completed_updates'] == self._completed_updates
+                  else Path(path).parent/Path(record['checkpoint']).name)
+        if not source.is_file():
+            candidate = Path(path).parent/'model_recovery_best.pt'
+            if candidate.is_file():

+                if (saved['completed_updates'] == record['completed_updates']
+                        and saved.get('best_recovery_checkpoint') == record):

+            print('[Best recovery checkpoint] Earlier selected policy is unavailable; selection restarts.',flush=True)

+        if self.gpu_global_rank == 0 and self.logger.log_dir:

+    def _write_best_checkpoint(self, source, record, stem='model_best'):
+        root = Path(self.logger.log_dir)
+        root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        destination = root/f'{stem}.pt'
+        if Path(source).resolve() != destination.resolve():
+            temporary = root/f'.{stem}.pt.tmp'
+            shutil.copyfile(source, temporary)
+            temporary.replace(destination)
+        temporary = root/f'.{stem}.json.tmp'
+        temporary.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2)+'\n')
+        temporary.replace(root/f'{stem}.json')

+                or not record.get('best_eligible')

+                or record['median_clearance_m'] <= cfg.min_median_clearance_m
+                or not record.get('score') or not all(map(math.isfinite, record['score']))):

+    def _evaluate_best_checkpoint(self, path):
+        env = self.env.unwrapped
+        if 'jump' not in env.cfg.commands or not self.logger.log_dir or self.gpu_global_rank != 0:
+            return False
+        cfg = env.cfg.commands['jump'].best_checkpoint
+        if (not cfg.enabled or self._jump_state is None or self._completed_updates < cfg.start_updates
+                or self._completed_updates <= self._jump_state['start_iteration']
+                or self._last_best_evaluation_updates == self._completed_updates):
+            return False
+        from .jump_evaluation import evaluate_jump_checkpoint
+        try:
+            result = evaluate_jump_checkpoint(env.cfg, self.alg.actor, cfg, self.device)

+                raise ValueError('Nonfinite or empty Jump checkpoint score')
+            record = dict(checkpoint=Path(path).name, completed_updates=self._completed_updates,
+                          evaluation=asdict(cfg), **result)
+            directory = Path(self.logger.log_dir)/'checkpoint_evaluations'
+            directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+            (directory/(Path(path).stem+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2)+'\n')

+                            'mean_peak_heading_error_deg', 'mean_final_heading_error_deg',
+                            'directional_landing_rate', 'landing_rate', 'takeoff_rate',
+                            'strict_success_rate', 'mean_joint_limit_violation_rad',
+                            'median_clearance_m', 'best_eligible'):
+                    self.logger.writer.add_scalar('JumpEvaluation/'+key, record[key], self.current_learning_iteration)

+                self._best_checkpoint is None or tuple(record['score']) > tuple(self._best_checkpoint['score']))

+            print('[Jump checkpoint evaluation]', Path(path).name, 'score:', record['score'],

+    def _load_legacy_curriculum(self, path):
+        """Recover older checkpoints' stage from their original run metadata."""
+        config_path = path.parent/'params/env.yaml'
+        if not config_path.is_file():
+            raise ValueError('Older Jump checkpoints require their original params/env.yaml to recover the curriculum')
+        config = yaml.load(config_path.read_text(), Loader=yaml.BaseLoader)['commands']['jump']
+        start = int(config['warmup_iterations'])
+        norm = self.alg.actor.obs_normalizer
+        self._jump_prior_primed = bool(torch.count_nonzero(norm._var[..., 36:40]))
+        if self._completed_updates <= start:
+            return
+        freeze_path = path.parent/'jump_actor_freeze.json'
+        if not freeze_path.is_file():
+            raise ValueError('Older Jump-stage checkpoints require jump_actor_freeze.json to recover their original Jump start')
+        frozen = json.loads(freeze_path.read_text())
+        start = int(frozen['completed_foundation_updates'])
+        ramp = min(1000., max(1., (int(config['total_iterations'])-start)/3))
+        self._jump_state = dict(start_iteration=start, ramp_iterations=ramp, learning_mode='full_actor')

+import sys
+import math
+from dataclasses import dataclass, replace
+from typing import Literal
+
+import mjlab
+import tyro
+from mjlab.scripts._cli import maybe_print_top_level_help
+from mjlab.scripts.train import TrainConfig as MjlabTrainConfig
+from mjlab.scripts.train import launch_training
+from mjlab.tasks.registry import load_env_cfg, load_rl_cfg
+from mjlab.utils.gpu import select_gpus
+from mjlab.managers import EventTermCfg
+from mjlab.managers.recorder_manager import RecorderTermCfg
+from .recovery_sampling import AdaptiveRecoverySampler
+from .recovery_curriculum import (DEFAULT_TRAINING_STATE_BANK, reset_curriculum_states,
+                                  curriculum_frames, training_state_bank)
+from .recovery import configure_recovery_rewards, sampling_metrics
+from . import JUMP_TASK_ID, TASK_ID
+from .distributed import resolve_gpu_ids
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class TrainConfig(MjlabTrainConfig):
+    gpu_ids: list[int] | Literal["all", "auto"] | None = "auto"
+    """Auto selects up to eight visible GPUs, otherwise CPU. num_envs is per GPU."""
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_task(cls, task_id):
+        """Assemble BENI defaults before applying command-line overrides."""
+        args = cls(env=load_env_cfg(task_id), agent=load_rl_cfg(task_id))
+        configure_recovery_curriculum(args)
+        if task_id == TASK_ID:
+            configure_recovery_rewards(args.env)
+        args.env.events["recovery_sampling_metrics"] = EventTermCfg(func=sampling_metrics, mode="step")
+        return args
+
+
+def validate_training(task_id, args):
+    if args.agent.max_iterations < 1:
+        raise ValueError('Training requires a positive number of PPO updates')
+    if task_id == JUMP_TASK_ID:
+        command = args.env.commands['jump']
+        if (command.play or command.warmup_iterations < 0 or not math.isfinite(command.ramp_iterations)
+                or command.ramp_iterations <= 0):
+            raise ValueError('Training requires a valid Jump curriculum, with play disabled')
+        command.recovery_gate.validate()
+        command.best_checkpoint.validate()
+    if 'reset_curriculum' in args.env.events:
+        training_state_bank(args.env.events['reset_curriculum'].params['bank_path'])
+
+
+def configure_recovery_curriculum(args):
+    """Configure recovery resets with the default training bank."""
+    args.env.curriculum = {}
+    args.env.events["reset_base"].params["fallen_probability"] = 0.
+    args.env.events["reset_curriculum"] = EventTermCfg(
+        func=reset_curriculum_states, mode="reset",
+        params={"bank_path": str(DEFAULT_TRAINING_STATE_BANK)})
+    args.env.events["curriculum_frames"] = EventTermCfg(func=curriculum_frames, mode="step")
+    args.env.recorders['recovery_sampling'] = RecorderTermCfg(func=AdaptiveRecoverySampler)
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    maybe_print_top_level_help("python -m beni_rl.train")
+    task_id, remaining_args = tyro.cli(
+        tyro.extras.literal_type_from_choices((TASK_ID, JUMP_TASK_ID)),
+        add_help=False,
+        return_unknown_args=True,
+        config=mjlab.TYRO_FLAGS,
+    )
+    args = tyro.cli(
+        TrainConfig,
+        args=remaining_args,
+        default=TrainConfig.from_task(task_id),
+        prog=sys.argv[0] + f" {task_id}",
+        config=mjlab.TYRO_FLAGS,
+    )
+    validate_training(task_id, args)
+    # The reset schedule uses actual PPO updates, not an independent clock.
+    args.env.events['reset_curriculum'].params['steps_per_iteration'] = args.agent.num_steps_per_env
+    args = replace(args, gpu_ids=resolve_gpu_ids(args.gpu_ids))
+    devices, count = select_gpus(args.gpu_ids)
+    print(f"[Training devices] {devices or 'CPU'}; environments per worker: {args.env.scene.num_envs}; "
+          f"total environments: {args.env.scene.num_envs * max(count, 1)}")
+    if count == 0:
+        print(
+            "[WARNING] Training on CPU is slow. Use a small --env.scene.num-envs value (e.g. 4).",
+            file=sys.stderr,
+        )
+    launch_training(task_id=task_id, args=args)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+class BeniVelocityCommand(UniformVelocityCommand):
+    """Velocity and pose commands with matching Viser controls."""
+
+    cfg: BeniVelocityCommandCfg
+
+    def __init__(self, cfg: BeniVelocityCommandCfg, env: ManagerBasedRlEnv):
+        super().__init__(cfg, env)
+        self.base_pose_command = torch.zeros(self.num_envs, 3, device=self.device)
+        self.base_pose_command[:, 2] = sum(cfg.height_range) / 2.0
+        self._pose_sliders = []
+
+    def _resample_command(self, env_ids: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+        super()._resample_command(env_ids)
+        if 'jump' in self._env.command_manager.active_terms:
+            self._env.command_manager.get_term('jump').release_heading(env_ids)
+        r = torch.empty(len(env_ids), device=self.device)
+        for index, axis in enumerate(("pitch", "roll", "height")):
+            self.base_pose_command[env_ids, index] = r.uniform_(*getattr(self.cfg, f"{axis}_range"))
+
+    def compute(self, dt: float | torch.Tensor, env_ids: torch.Tensor | None = None) -> None:
+        jump = (self._env.command_manager.get_term('jump')
+                if 'jump' in self._env.command_manager.active_terms else None)
+        if jump is not None:
+            # Pause command resampling until this jump lands or times out.
+            held = jump.command_hold
+            if env_ids is None:
+                self.time_left += held * dt
+            else:
+                self.time_left[env_ids] += held[env_ids] * dt
+        super().compute(dt, env_ids)
+        if jump is not None:
+            self.vel_command_b[held] = jump.state['request_twist'][held]
+            # An explicit joystick turn ends a completed jump's heading hold.
+            # During preparation/flight/landing it cannot override straight Jump.
+            if self._joystick_enabled is not None and self._joystick_enabled.value:
+                index = self._joystick_get_env_idx()
+                if abs(self._joystick_sliders[2].value) > 1e-6:
+                    jump.release_heading(jump._env_ids[index:index+1])
+            self.vel_command_b[jump.heading_active, 2] = 0.
+        if self._joystick_enabled is not None and self._joystick_enabled.value:
+            assert self._joystick_get_env_idx is not None
+            for index, slider in enumerate(self._pose_sliders):
+                self.base_pose_command[self._joystick_get_env_idx(), index] = slider.value
+
+    def create_gui(
+        self,
+        name: str,
+        server: "viser.ViserServer",
+        get_env_idx: Callable[[], int],
+        on_change: Callable[[], None] | None = None,
+        request_action: Callable[[str, Any], None] | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        self._joystick_get_env_idx = get_env_idx
+        self._joystick_sliders = []
+        self._pose_sliders = []
+        with server.gui.add_folder(name.capitalize()):
+            self._joystick_enabled = server.gui.add_checkbox("Enable", initial_value=False)
+            for axis in ("lin_vel_x", "lin_vel_y", "ang_vel_z"):

+                        step=0.05,

+                        disabled=lower == upper,
+                    )
+                )
+            for axis in ("pitch", "roll", "height"):

+                self._pose_sliders.append(

+                        f"base_{axis} ({unit})",
+                        min=lower,

+"""Finite wheel overspeed termination with a short, unmodified state history."""
+
+import math
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import time
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+
+
+class WheelOverspeed:
+    """Check actual wheel speed at the native control-step termination boundary.
+
+    Nonfinite states retain the existing fail-fast observation behavior. This
+    term neither repairs observations nor changes optimizer/learning-rate state.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, cfg, env):
+        limit = cfg.params.get('max_speed', 350.)
+        history = cfg.params.get('history_s', .5)
+        if not math.isfinite(limit) or limit <= 0 or not math.isfinite(history) or history <= 0:
+            raise ValueError('Wheel speed limit and history duration must be finite and positive')
+        self.wheels = env.scene['robot'].find_joints(('LW', 'RW'), preserve_order=True)[0]
+        self.capacity = max(2, math.ceil(history / env.step_dt) + 1)
+        self.history = {}
+        self.cursor = self.count = 0
+        self.limit = limit
+        self.step_dt = env.step_dt
+        self.rank = int(os.environ.get('RANK', '0'))
+        env._wheel_overspeed = self
+
+    def capture(self, env):
+        data = env.sim.data
+        robot = env.scene['robot'].data
+        frame = dict(qpos=data.qpos, qvel=data.qvel, qacc=data.qacc,
+                     ctrl=data.ctrl, actuator_force=data.actuator_force,
+                     action=env.action_manager.action,
+                     joint_velocity_target=robot.joint_vel_target,
+                     wheel_speed=robot.joint_vel[:, self.wheels],
+                     base_ang_vel=robot.root_link_ang_vel_b,
+                     body_contact_force=env.scene['body_ground_contact'].data.force,
+                     wheel_contact_force=env.scene['wheel_ground_contact'].data.force,
+                     episode_step=env.episode_length_buf,
+                     control_step=torch.full_like(env.episode_length_buf, env.common_step_counter))
+        for name, attr in (('reset_kind', '_curriculum_kind'), ('reset_state_id', '_recovery_state_id')):
+            if hasattr(env, attr):
+                frame[name] = getattr(env, attr)
+        for name, value in frame.items():
+            if name not in self.history:
+                self.history[name] = torch.full((self.capacity, *value.shape), -1,
+                                                dtype=value.dtype, device=value.device)
+            self.history[name][self.cursor].copy_(value)
+        self.cursor = (self.cursor + 1) % self.capacity
+        self.count = min(self.count + 1, self.capacity)
+
+    def dump(self, env, ids, reason):
+        if not len(ids) or not self.count:
+            return
+        directory = Path(getattr(env, '_diagnostics_dir', 'logs/diagnostics/wheel_overspeed')) / f'rank_{self.rank}'
+        directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        order = (torch.arange(self.count, device=env.device) + self.cursor-self.count) % self.capacity
+        record = {name: value[order[:, None], ids[None, :]].cpu().numpy()
+                  for name, value in self.history.items()}
+        record.update(env_ids=ids.cpu().numpy(), reason=np.array(reason), rank=np.array(self.rank),
+                      control_dt_s=np.array(self.step_dt), max_speed_rad_s=np.array(self.limit),
+                      wheel_joint_names=np.array(['LW', 'RW']),
+                      body_contact_names=np.array(env.scene['body_ground_contact'].primary_names),
+                      capture_phase=np.array('pre-reset control boundary; derived/contact state lags one physics substep'))
+        path = directory / f'{reason}_step_{env.common_step_counter}_{time.time_ns()}.npz'
+        np.savez_compressed(path, **record)
+        print(f'[Wheel diagnostics] {len(ids)} environments: {path}', flush=True)
+
+    def __call__(self, env, max_speed=350., history_s=.5):
+        self.capture(env)
+        speed = env.scene['robot'].data.joint_vel[:, self.wheels]
+        # Do not turn an already nonfinite transition into an automatic reset.
+        finite = torch.ones(env.num_envs, device=env.device, dtype=torch.bool)
+        for value in (env.sim.data.qpos, env.sim.data.qvel, env.sim.data.qacc, env.sim.data.sensordata):
+            finite &= torch.isfinite(value).all(-1)
+        terminated = finite & (speed.abs() > max_speed).any(-1)
+        log = env.extras.setdefault('log', {})
+        log['WheelSafety/max_abs_speed_rad_s'] = speed.abs().max()
+        log['WheelSafety/overspeed_count'] = terminated.sum()
+        ids = terminated.nonzero().flatten()
+        if len(ids):
+            self.dump(env, ids, 'overspeed')
+        return terminated
+
+    @torch.inference_mode()
+    def dump_failure(self, env):
+        """Save evidence on an existing exception; the caller re-raises it unchanged."""
+        self.capture(env)
+        invalid = torch.zeros(env.num_envs, device=env.device, dtype=torch.bool)
+        for value in (env.sim.data.qpos, env.sim.data.qvel, env.sim.data.qacc, env.sim.data.sensordata,
+                      env.scene['robot'].data.root_link_ang_vel_b):
+            invalid |= ~torch.isfinite(value).all(-1)
+        self.dump(env, invalid.nonzero().flatten(), 'physics_failure')

+
+The browser runs the repository's current BENI robot model and policy using MuJoCo WASM and ONNX Runtime Web.
+
+## Development and runtime
+
+Build requirements: Node.js 22.13+ and Python 3.9+ available as `python3` (standard library only; no training dependencies). Build from a full repository checkout: the asset exporter reads `../assets/` and `../python/`, so `web/` alone cannot be installed or built. Commands below use POSIX shell syntax; on Windows, use an environment that provides `python3`, such as WSL.
+
+Run from this `web/` directory:
+
+```bash
+npm ci
+npm run dev
+# Production: npm run build && npm start
+```
+
+Open `http://localhost:3000/`. The server listens on `0.0.0.0:3000` by default; use `HOST=127.0.0.1` to bind only to this machine, or `PORT=3003 npm run dev` to run alongside another worktree's server. `predev` / `prebuild` prepare WASM from locked npm dependencies and precompile all three fixed courses into compressed MJB files. Initial generation takes tens of seconds; results are cached in `public/runtime/tracks/` and reused while inputs remain unchanged.
+
+## How to play
+
+1. Enter a **Driver name** and select **Enter garage**. Choose a course and skin.
+2. For a solo run, keep **Single Player** selected and choose **Start game**.
+3. To race with friends, select **Multiplayer**. Choose **Create room**, join a listed open room, or enter a five-character room code. Share the room's invite link or code. Everyone selects **Ready up**; the host then selects **Start race**. Rooms hold up to eight drivers, and races last two laps.
+4. Follow the course to finish both laps. Collect gems for points and occasional boosts. After the race, the host can choose **Race again**.
+
+If the Multiplayer option is absent, this deployment offers Single Player only.
+
+### Controls
+
+| Input | Action |
+| --- | --- |
+| W/A/S/D or arrow keys | Drive and steer |
+| Space | Jump |
+| R | Return to the course (+3 seconds) |
+| C | Switch camera |
+| Touchscreen | Steer with the left joystick; use the Jump and Reset buttons on the right |
+
+Use **Settings** to change effects quality and toggle the minimap or driver names.
+
+## Verification
+
+After `npm ci`, these commands work in a fresh checkout:
+
+```bash
+npm run typecheck
+npm run build
+npm run test:laps
+```
+
+`test:laps` runs the bundled policy with MuJoCo WASM and ONNX on all three
+courses from three starting slots, including both split routes, for two laps.
+It writes reports under `outputs/lap-verification/`; see
+`tools/demo-recorder/README.md` for options.
+
+## Optional asset CDN
+
+Set `VITE_ASSET_BASE_URL` at build time to an immutable asset release directory, for example `https://huggingface.co/spaces/OWNER/SPACE/resolve/COMMIT/dist`. Robot assets, policy files, physics binaries and compiled tracks use this base; API requests and WebSocket connections remain same-origin. Leave it unset for a self-contained deployment.
+
+Publish the asset snapshot first, then build the frontend with that snapshot's commit. Keep the ONNX runtime JavaScript module same-origin. Runtime asset downloads are limited to four concurrent transfers per context and retry the selected source up to three times. A transfer aborts only after 60 seconds without incoming data, not after a fixed total duration. Failed CDN transfers never automatically fall back to the Space; the error panel offers a CDN retry or an explicit backup-source reload. The public Space includes the complete source snapshot and assets, but never the original Git history, credentials or local diagnostics.
+
+For HF-hosted frontend bundles, set server variable `FRONTEND_ASSET_BASE_URL` to the immutable release directory containing the exact deployed build. The tiny same-origin HTML loader fetches JS/CSS concurrently and loads typed Blob modules because HF serves JavaScript downloads as plain text. A Blob worker bootstrap queues early messages and fetches the matching worker, using the same idle timeout and selected-source retries as runtime downloads. Source changes require the player to choose the backup explicitly. Do not mix this variable with a different frontend build. Without it, normal local script and worker loading is unchanged.
+
+Startup progress reports downloaded/required MB for the current initial course's physics assets; cached assets are excluded from the download total. Rendering-only skins load separately on demand. Successful runtime downloads are size/SHA-256 verified and stored in Cache Storage by content hash, shared between CDN and explicit backup mode. Refreshes reuse unchanged files; new skins or courses download only missing assets. Cache cleanup runs at most daily per cache and removes entries unused for 30 days; it does not remove another release merely because the current manifest changed. Frontend scripts/styles and worker source use immutable release URL keys. Cache access/quota failures are nonfatal; private browsing, cleared site data or browser eviction can require another download. Initialization still runs after a cache hit.
+
+## Loading checks and source deployment
+
+The canonical upstream is `https://github.com/Mondo-Robotics/open-beni.git`. Run builds and exports from this checkout. Hugging Face is the deployment target, not a separate development repository.
+
+The shared transport lives in `loading/download.mjs`; `loading/cache.mjs` handles optional persistence. The page and worker bootstraps are maintained source modules, bundled by `scripts/build-loaders.mjs`. Course changes cancel superseded downloads and establish a fresh progress plan.
+
+Run `npm run test:loading` for retry, idle timeout, cancellation and cache tests. After building and starting a server, run `GAME_URL=http://localhost:3000/ node tools/loading-checks/browser.mjs` for browser checks. `MOCK_CDN=1` uses local built payloads with HF-like response types; omit it when checking the real Space. Run `node tools/loading-checks/worker-race.mjs` against the local server to verify a map change interrupts an in-flight download. Chrome must be installed; `CHROME_BIN` overrides its path.
+
+Build with the desired immutable `VITE_ASSET_BASE_URL`, then run `python3 web/scripts/export-space.py /path/to/new-export` from the repository root. This exports the complete source snapshot plus `dist/` for CDN delivery, without Git history or ignored local files. It preserves the destination Space's existing `.gitattributes`, which HF needs to resolve binary assets through LFS. The default destination is `mondo-robotics/open-beni`; use `--space OWNER/SPACE` for another existing public Space. Do not overwrite those attributes with the source repository's version. Upload that export to the Space, then set the Space runtime variable `FRONTEND_ASSET_BASE_URL` to `https://huggingface.co/spaces/OWNER/SPACE/resolve/SNAPSHOT/dist`, using the returned upload revision. Before enabling it, run `node web/scripts/check-space.mjs https://YOUR-SPACE.hf.space/` against the completed source build; it must match the local export. Preserve the runtime CDN build argument used for the exported build. The Docker image builds from source; checked-in generated `dist/` is only the immutable CDN payload.
+
+The root Dockerfile builds with Node 24.11.1 and Python 3, then runs the game as a non-root user on `0.0.0.0:7860`. The full training code is published but is not installed or executed by the game server.
